explication: Yosemite Crew is an animal-health operating system centered on a veterinary practice information management system (PIMS), with web and mobile apps, integrations, and developer-facing capabilities around it. A typical user workflow is to use a connected app to work with veterinary practice functions and receive the resulting information or service. The tree shows broad backend domains—appointments, clinical records, billing, labs, and integrations—plus a desktop client with offline synchronization and a shared PDF library. Most backend routing and persistence connections were not sampled, so those internal relationships are not asserted here.
